season_context.current_fashion_season: Autumn/Winter 2026 (AW26); post-Diwali festive and wedding season
season_context.local_season_notes: Diwali has just passed and the main wedding season runs about November to February, with cool northern winters and mild southern weather, so velvet, silks and layers dominate wedding buying. Spring/summer 2027 collections follow from March, with LFW typically held in March and October.

sources.title: Lakmé Fashion Week x FDCI October 2026 line-up
Stars dazzle at Delhi Lakmé Fashion Week 2026

trends.name: Saturated jewel tones
trends.summary: Fall 2026 wedding wear favours true emerald, sapphire and ruby over the dusty pinks of recent years, with emerald lehengas in gold zardozi a standout.

trends.name: Wine, plum and antique bronze
trends.summary: For winter wedding lehengas, deep plum, wine, bottle green and muted antique bronze or warm gold are recommended over bright reflective gold.

trends.name: Velvet, Banarasi and brocade for winter
trends.summary: Winter guests are steered to velvet, Banarasi and Kanjivaram silk, raw silk, brocade and fully lined embroidered net instead of light georgette or chiffon.

trends.name: Covered-up winter ethnic shapes
trends.summary: Lehengas with full or three-quarter sleeve blouses, floor-length silk or velvet anarkalis, and sarees with structured long-sleeve blouses suit cooler November-December weddings.

trends.name: Velvet dupattas and indo-western jackets
trends.summary: Instead of plain wool shawls, guests layer heavily embroidered or velvet dupattas used as wraps, or tailored velvet and embroidered indo-western jackets.

trends.name: Ivory and white bridal looks
trends.summary: Ivory lehengas, white sarees and cream sets with gold or silver work are a major 2026 bridal direction, helped by destination weddings and shifting views of white.

trends.name: Ivory as understated luxury
trends.summary: A September 2026 bridal colour guide names ivory a defining shade of the year because it lets embroidery and textiles lead, alongside enduring reds, pinks and gold.

trends.name: Corsets, bandeaus and capes
trends.summary: Bridal looks swap traditional cholis for structured corsets and bandeau bustiers, often topped with sheer embroidered capes or overlays alongside the dupatta.

trends.name: Texture over sparkle
trends.summary: Lace, tone-on-tone embroidery and appliqué are replacing heavy sequins, often in monochrome looks like ivory on ivory or champagne on champagne.

trends.name: Modular bridalwear
trends.summary: Separates, detachable sleeves and removable layers let one bridal outfit shift from ceremony to reception; fringes and tassels add movement.

trends.name: Tailoring-led groomswear
trends.summary: Grooms favour gold, ivory, cream and beige with cut and fabric doing the work, embroidery confined to a collar, cuff or panel, and personality added via brooches and jewelled buttons.

trends.name: Festive luxury pret at LFW October
trends.summary: Lakmé Fashion Week x FDCI ran 13-18 October 2026 in Delhi; Manish Malhotra returned after three years with festive luxury pret, and Amit Aggarwal closed the season.

trends.name: Regional craft and circular design
trends.summary: The October 2026 LFW x FDCI season spotlighted Ladakh artisans in a dedicated presentation and staged a circular-design challenge final with the UN in India.

trends.name: Dark base, bright accents
trends.summary: The AW26 palette pairs wine, bottle green and ochre foundations with butter yellow, peach and turquoise accents; Indian labels use ochre, rust and indigo as entry points.

trends.name: Colour-blocked festive kurta sets
trends.summary: Colour blocking reaches Indian festive kurta sets, couture and menswear in softer contrasts, often anchored with neutrals or metallic embroidery for sangeets and cocktails.

trends.name: Balloon and puff sleeves
trends.summary: Sculptural balloon and gathered sleeves lead AW26 silhouettes globally; in India, puff and balloon sleeves are a common blouse detail on bridal and saree looks.

trends.name: Tangerine at weddings
trends.summary: Tangerine is emerging as a fresh alternative to wedding reds and magentas for guests and some brides, paired with Banarasi weaves, zardozi and contrast dupattas.

trends.name: Kamarbandh waist jewellery
trends.summary: The kamarbandh waist belt is back on celebrity and bridal sarees and lehengas in 2026, used to structure heavy silk drapes.

trends.name: Craft-led knitwear
trends.summary: Evening knitwear is a fall theme, and Indian craft-led labels such as Nicobar and Khajoor Studio use hand-knitting, organic yarns and artisan partnerships.

trends.name: Tartan outerwear
trends.summary: Tartan is moving from shirting into Indian autumn-winter outerwear such as shackets, blazers and swing jackets.

trends.name: Narrow trousers return
trends.summary: Slimmer trousers are back for AW26, with Indian formal and smart-casual labels already offering narrower fits.

trends.name: Slate grey for menswear
trends.summary: Slate grey is positioned as a softer winter neutral than black, used by Indian labels for tailoring, kurta sets and menswear.

trends.name: Opera dressing
trends.summary: Trade coverage argues quiet luxury is giving way to theatrical coats and shawls, a mood tied to India's velvet, brocade and embroidered festive wear.

trends.name: Art Deco beads and fringe
trends.summary: Fall maximalism brings beading, fringe and feathers, which trade press links to Mumbai's Indo-Deco heritage for Indian labels.

trends.name: Block print and handweaving on the runway
trends.summary: At LFW in March 2026, designers built craft into collections through hand embroidery, handweaving, block printing, patchwork and natural fibres.

trends.name: Khadi denim and utility menswear
trends.summary: LFW March 2026 opened with a menswear showcase and featured khadi denim, utility pieces and gender-blurring tailoring, with fringe and tassels across several labels.

trends.name: Cummerbunds and waist definition
trends.summary: SS27 shows revived the cummerbund; Indian menswear is adopting it in tuxedo styling, while womenswear uses kamarbandhs and structured skirt-corset sets.

trends.name: Corset bodices and short capes for 2027 brides
trends.summary: For 2027 weddings, corset bodices over sarees or anarkalis, short embellished capes with mirror or Parsi gara work, and jewelled blouses are tipped to lead.

trends.name: Architectural cutwork
trends.summary: 2027 bridal forecasts highlight cutwork that removes fabric to make latticed negative-space designs, often finished with cutdana.

trends.name: Oversized placed florals
trends.summary: Bridal prints for 2027 are expected to scale botanicals up and place them deliberately rather than repeating small motifs.
